text:
Ravi: hey team! Ravi here, starting today as a product designer. quick Qs to get me unstuck: i clicked the Figma org invite but it still shows "request access". also trying to locate the current product roadmap and any past user interview templates in Notion. who's best to ping for a 10-min setup? thanks :)

Product Onboarding Bot: welcome Ravi :tada:  Invite attempted to ravi@redwood.ai. If you still see the request screen after 5 minutes try: `/resend_invite figma ravi@redwood.ai`. Roadmap overview: https://redwood-internal.notion.site/Product-Roadmap-Overview-9c12. Research templates: Notion > Product > Research > Templates. Join channels: #design, #product, #research-ops.

Ravi: tried resend, still seeing the request page. clicking "request access" doesn't progress.

Lena: hey Ravi  welcome!! i'll add you manually. what's your figma email (confirm DM'd). i can also do a 10-min walkthrough of our file structure at 2pm. we'll cover: published libraries, file naming conventions, prototype flows, and device test lab booking. do you need mobile device access?

Product Onboarding Bot: manual add queued by Lena. If you hit the request page after this, try a browser hard refresh or open https://www.figma.com/files/recent in incognito.

Ravi: can open Figma now, thanks Lena!

Owen: welcome Ravi. Roadmap detail lives in Notion (link above) and our milestones are mirrored to Linear. For feature context look at the Feature Briefs folder in Notion and the corresponding Linear epic. Competitive notes and recent research summaries are under Product > Insights.

Ravi: great. one more: where are past interview scripts? i want to reuse a recruiting screener.

Priya: hi Ravi, i'm Priya (Research Ops)  added you to the Research Notion workspace and the S3 bucket `redwood-user-research`. Interview scripts live in Research > Studies > Archived Studies (each study page has a "scripts" section + recording links). i also pushed a short starter pack: https://redwood-internal.notion.site/Research-Starter-Pack-e7f3. if you can't access S3 use `SSO -> Apps -> AWS -> Request S3 Read` and ping me.

Ravi: awesome, i see the starter pack. quick process Q: if i want to run a small guerrilla test next week, do i need approvals?

Priya: small guerrilla tests (2-5 users) typically just need a short intake note in Notion and the recruitment tag in the Research backlog. for compensated participants or anything requiring PII we do the ethics checklist. i'll DM you the intake template.

Lena: also FYI we have a weekly design critique on Wednesdays 4pm. i'll add you to the calendar. we expect a 1-slide problem + 5 minutes of context.

Ravi: perfect, thanks everyone. last tiny ask: is there a canonical place for design tokens and do we sync tokens to figma?

Lena: tokens live in the Design System Notion page and are published as a Figma library named "Design Tokens". we use the Tokens plugin for sync. if anything is out of sync ping @lena and i'll republish.

Owen: if you want to pair on onboarding tomorrow i can show you the roadmap-to-OKR mapping and where we keep user metrics. happy to block 30m.

Ravi: i'd love that, thanks Owen. appreciate the warm welcome :raised_hands:

Product Onboarding Bot: checklist summary: Figma access  confirmed; Notion  Product + Research access confirmed; Linear  request via SSO if needed; S3  read access to `redwood-user-research`; Meetings  Design critique + Research sync invites sent.

Ravi: all set, closing this thread — see you in the critique on Wednesday!"
